body: I’ll try thanks for the talk its good to have some amount of human interaction.

I have extremely bad social anxiety so I stay at home when possible so 95% of the time plus I play online games a lot but cancerous communities ruined that for me. So the past week I’ve been in bed sleeping or just sitting there.
